name: Age of Mythology: Atlanteans
description:
Turns the Atlanteans of Age of Mythology: Retold into a town: 43 creatures (seven town levels, each with a base form and two alternative upgrades, plus out-of-town units), 3 hero classes and 25 heroes. 2 racial skills (Triune Order, Divine Echo). 12 god powers, plus Return to Atlantis, which can be learned only after the Grail is built. Town: building tree, dwellings, mage guild, town screen with animated buildings, hall, map look, siege screen, puzzle map, tavern video, music, boat and map dwellings. Artifacts: the Titan Legacy set (7 components and 1 combination artifact). Also tavern rumors, the town's war machine Cheiroballista, the creature bank Tartarean Rift and three dwellings for out-of-town units. Commander: the Chief Oracle. Submods: Coastal Land Terrain (originally by Zeryss, made the native terrain of Atlantis) and Atlantis Wiki Page (a page explaining the mechanics in the in-game wiki).

Credits: the models, textures and animations of creatures, heroes, buildings and effects, as well as sounds and music, come from Age of Mythology: Retold (© Microsoft / World's Edge) and were rendered for VCMI by the author; the town screen, buildings, portraits and icons were repainted with AI (OpenArt) on top of those renders. This is a non-commercial fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or World's Edge.

chinese.name: 神话时代：大西洲
chinese.description:
把《神话时代：重述版》的大西洲做成一座城镇：43个兵种（本城7级，每级一个基础形态和两种平级的升级形态，另有城外兵），3个英雄职业、25位英雄。种族二级技能2个（三相御令、神力回响）。神力法术12个，另有建成圣杯后才能学的重返大西洲。城镇：建筑树、巢穴、魔法行会、城镇画面和建筑动画、大厅、地图外观、攻城画面、藏宝图、酒馆视频、音乐、船、城外巢穴。宝物：泰坦遗宝套装（7个部件和1个组合宝物）。另有酒馆传闻、本城战争器械手弩炮、宝屋冥界裂口和三座城外兵巢穴。指挥官神谕长。子模组：海滩地形（原作者 Zeryss，设为大西洲的本地地形）、大西洲百科（游戏百科里的机制讲解页）。

素材来源：兵种、英雄、建筑和特效的模型、贴图、动作，以及音效和音乐，取自《神话时代：重述版》（Age of Mythology: Retold，© Microsoft / World's Edge），由作者渲染转换到 VCMI；城镇画面、建筑、头像和图标在这些渲染图的基础上用 AI（OpenArt）重绘。本 mod 是非商业的同人作品，与 Microsoft、World's Edge 无关，也未获其认可。
